resources.string: Offline English keyboard. As you type or paste, improved versions of the message appear above the keys. Tap one to use it. Hold a top-row letter for its number.
PoliteType is not enabled. Open Language and input settings, turn it on, then choose it as your keyboard.
PoliteType is enabled. Choose it as the keyboard you are using.
PoliteType is the keyboard you are using.
Type here after you switch to PoliteType
Spelling, grammar, and tone run on this phone. Nothing you type is sent to a server. This app has no account and no internet permission.
PoliteType could not open. Switch to another keyboard, then open PoliteType again.
No crash recorded yet. If PoliteType closes, open this screen again. The reason is also saved in Android/data/com.politetype.ime/files/crash-log.txt.
